title: She Saw Keys Were Left Inside a Random Car So She Did This
description:
► Code Blue Cam Merch 
http://www.codebluecam.com/

On February 20, 2023, police were called to a vehicle theft in progress in Wausau, WI. A 24-year-old woman stole a vehicle after the owner left the keys inside the unlocked car. Following a pursuit that covered several miles, the suspect ultimately lost control of the vehicle and slid into a ditch. Further investigation revealed that this incident was not her initial involvement in vehicle theft.

The purpose of the featured content is to show the law enforcement interaction. It is NOT to publicly shame, ridicule, or degrade the individuals involved. Today’s world is swarmed with politics and conversations that are often misleading about our law enforcement officers. We feel it is vastly significant and imperative to show these interactions in their respective environments to inform and educate the overall public.
